name: Tarteel
description:
Tarteel's MCP server brings the Quran to any AI assistant. It lets you
search and recite ayahs, read scholarly tafsir commentary, explore
translations in dozens of languages, browse reciters, and get accurate
Islamic prayer times for any city worldwide. Tools render as interactive
widgets inside supported clients, making
Quranic knowledge directly accessible in conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tarteel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tarteel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tarteel.ai/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Tarteel MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Tarteel scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tarteel MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tarteel provides these MCP tools: ayah_mutashabihat, phrase_mutashabihat, ayah_translation, ayah_tafsir, list_reciters, list_tafsirs, list_translations, play_ayahs, and prayer_times.
Tarteel does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Tarteel is developed by Tarteel AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
